entities.summary: Emil Martinsen Lilleberg is a Norwegian ice hockey player who is a defenceman for the Tampa Bay Lightning of the National Hockey League (NHL). Internationally, Lilleberg represents the Norwegian national team. He made his NHL debut in 2024.
